text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fierce battle came to an end. Everyone gave their run everything they had, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright was just staring intently at Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What a truly... magnificent run it was...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Have we ever seen a race like this before?
No, we have not~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "I have not. And for me... it is a style of running that the Mejiro family cannot do..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Suzuka, so that is
the true you~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, Bright... But I'm not finished yet. The moment I can reach beyond the scenery is...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
There, without a doubt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that... so? In that case, I must shine even brighter than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As we are now, it won't reach. And just as the scenery
beyond your sight lies even further ahead~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our Mejiro ideals
still lie further ahead—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Suzuka-sama,
would you run with us again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before, I may have been the one to give you your start.
However, today, it was you who taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going. I can deliver a run
far more worthy of the Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is why... it has to be the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes—it's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having shown each other their cards, the two push each other
even further, heading toward the ultimate stage.
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn). Feeling that something momentous might happen once we give it our absolute all, we must make every possible preparation for that day.
